Ownership (the "Owner" column) now comes from the Parent-Child mapping file's DSM/ZH/RH columns. Where a dealer's DSM was blank or marked "TBH" (not yet hired / placeholder), ownership rolls up to that dealer's ZH; if the ZH is also missing, it rolls up to the RH. This affected 1,398 of 4,333 child records (~32%) — 656 Parent IDs are now shown as ZH-owned and 7 as RH-owned rather than DSM-owned. A few dealers (~4% of mapped parents) had children pointing to more than one DSM/ZH in the source file; the most common assignment was used. 172 Parent IDs have no record in this mapping file and keep their original DSM/ZH/RH assignment unchanged.
Issuance for May–Aug'26 now comes from the Child-level issuance file, aggregated up to each Parent ID via the real Child ID → Parent ID map (1,834 of 2,006 Parent IDs). Aug'26 is a final month total for those, replacing the earlier 29-day normalized estimate. The remaining 172 Parent IDs have no child-level records in the new file, so they still show the earlier normalized Aug estimate (flagged in each row's detail view). Growth/Degrowth status, streaks, peaks and gaps have all been recalculated against these updated numbers.
Parent-wise shows each Parent ID's full 10-month issuance trail (Nov'25–Aug'26). Child-wise shows each individual Child ID (the actual dealer location) with its own 4-month issuance (May–Aug'26) and Parent ID for reference — issuance history before May isn't available at the child level. Visit detail in Child-wise view is a direct match (the visit log is keyed by Child ID), so it's more precise than the Parent-wise view where multiple children sharing a parent can share credit for the same visit.
